title: AuraSkills [Glue] Plan Player Analytics
body:
This plugin adds data from AuraSkills to Plan Player Analytics.

At this moment the following data are collected:
- Player Skills
- Player Stats
- Player Traits
- Player Abilities
- Player Average Skill Level
- Player Power Level
- Player Mana / Max Mana
- Player Locale (because why not? AuraSkillsAPI has a function for it)
- Player Jobs (as groups)
- Player Job Limit
